screens.name: PaymentScreen (subscription wall / upgrade sheet)
screens.purpose: Sells the single com.marque.pro.monthly subscription ($19.99/mo, 7-day trial). Serves two roles from one view: the onboarding SOFT wall (root gate, non-dismissible, with a 'continue with watermark' free-tier escape) and the dismissible 'Wall 2' upgrade sheet at publish/schedule/post moments.

screens.reachedFrom: After OnboardingView completes (before sign-in — paywall precedes auth in the gate machine); from Library post-now sheet, Library schedule sheet, and Performance/Schedule post detail when a free-tier user tries to publish.

screens.functionalCoupling: @Environment(AppStore.self) store; @Environment(\.dismiss). Reads store.subscription.monthly / .products.first?.displayPrice, store.subscription.lastError, store.subscription.isSubscribed, store.brand.goal, store.brand.weeklyTarget. Calls await store.subscription.load() in .task, store.subscription.purchase(), store.subscription.restore(), store.backend.reportClientEvent('paywall_view', detail: 'upgrade_sheet'|'onboarding_gate'), reportClientEvent('paywall_action', detail: 'subscribe'|'purchase_success'|'continue_free'). Fallback price string '$19.99' must remain aligned to ASC. SubscriptionManager lives in /Users/home/Marque/ios/Marque/Adapters/Billing.swift.

areas.notes: Scope covered fully: the three files in /Users/home/Marque/ios/Marque/Features/Gate/ (PaymentScreen.swift, SignInScreen.swift, YunicornProPaywall.swift) plus every presentation site found by grep. There is no other paywall view in the app: 'SubscriptionGateView' and 'PaywallView' are referenced only in comments (dead names); 'Paywall' otherwise appears only in comments in MarqueApp/Billing/Onboarding/SettingsIcons/TourOverlay. All three gate screens are DARK treatments inside an otherwise light app (MarqueApp forces .preferredColorScheme(.light) at the root; YunicornProPaywall re-forces .dark on itself) — a black-and-white Stoic redesign will need to decide whether the gate stays dark or inverts, and must handle the root-level .light override for dark-mode support. Important couplings to keep: (1) the gate order onboarding → PaymentScreen (soft wall) → SignInScreen → app is decided in RootView (MarqueApp.swift:79-92), not in these views; (2) App Review constraints baked into PaymentScreen/YunicornProPaywall: Restore control must exist on any selling screen (3.1.1), and the billed monthly amount must be the most conspicuous price element with trial copy subordinate and the CTA carrying the amount (3.1.2(c), prior rejection of build 82) — the redesign must preserve this hierarchy; (3) Apple sign-in intentionally uses a hand-driven ASAuthorizationController + custom button so Google/Apple share identical chrome (guideline 4.8 requires Apple when Google is offered) — keep AppleSignInCoordinator and both buttons; (4) all accessibilityIdentifiers listed per screen are used by Maestro flows and must be preserved; (5) 'Forgot password?' has an empty action today — keep the control, do not add behavior; (6) PaymentScreen's fixed (non-scrolling) VStack with a maxHeight-infinity feature card is a known squeeze risk on iPhone SE — the SE requirement may justify switching to a ScrollView as a presentation-only change; (7) YunicornProPaywall does not surface store.subscription.lastError while PaymentScreen does — if the redesign unifies the two paywall bodies, keep PaymentScreen's error line and free-tier escape and YunicornProPaywall's paid state + DEBUG revoke. Colors currently used in scope: Palette.ink/night #1C1A17, DarkParity.ink #0B0B0D, error #FF6B5E, Palette.positive #2F9E60, white at 0.04/0.06/0.08/0.09/0.12/0.14/0.20/0.24/0.42/0.45/0.55/0.58/0.70/0.72/0.85 opacities; GoogleGMark default #4285F4 (rendered white on this screen). screens.name: Voice Orb (shared animated glyph)
screens.purpose: Canvas-rendered animated ink-drop orb whose edge deforms with voice level; four modes idle/listening/thinking/speaking. Used by VoiceBubble (124pt) and VoiceSessionView (148pt).
screens.presentation: inline component (TimelineView(.animation) + Canvas)
screens.reachedFrom: VoiceBubble on Home; VoiceSessionView orb/mic button
structureTopToBottom: Layout frame exactly `size`; canvas overscanned 1.3x, allowsHitTesting false, accessibilityHidden
Draw order: warm blurred cast shadow → (listening only) accent-blue stroked rim (width 2.4%–4.6% of size scaled by envelope, opacity by listen blend) → solid ink fill of the 144-sample harmonic path
interactive: none directly (contentShape Circle; parent Button handles taps)
states: idle: quiet breathing, faint ±2% ripple, boil rate 0.45
listening: ripple + swell track mic level (level param), rim takes accent blue 0x2C6BED
thinking: fine wobble off, low-lobe lopsided lump rotating ~0.95 rad/s, slow 0.4Hz swell
speaking: body pulses with TTS amplitude on low lobes, rim stays ink
Mode blends eased at 7/s so switches never snap
screens.styleNotes: Hardcoded colors: ink 0x1C1A17, accent 0x2C6BED, shadow 0x2E2A20. Pure monochrome except the listening rim (blue). Physics: envelope follower (35ms attack / 220ms release), damped springs, seeded harmonics k=2,3,6,7,9. Renders identically in light/dark (no scheme awareness).
screens.functionalCoupling: Inputs: mode (VoiceOrb.Mode), level 0…1, size. Everything else is self-contained (OrbPhysics @State). A redesign may recolor via InkDrop constants but should not change the mode/level API used by VoiceSessionView (orbMode/orbLevel).

areas.notes: Key facts for the redesign: (1) Home is the only tab with a hidden nav bar and its own top bar (date kicker / streak / avatar) plus a status-bar canvas fade overlay. (2) The whole scope is hardcoded light-mode via Palette hex constants and VoiceOrb's private InkDrop colors; SkeletonBlock also hardcodes 0xE6E5E2/0xF7F7F5. Dark-mode support must come from making Palette adaptive — none of the Home views branch on colorScheme, except ReelFeedPager which forces .dark. (3) Non-monochrome colors currently used in Home scope: accent blue (picks eyebrow bar, avatar ring/initial, bookmark, like-selected, trend dot, orb listening rim, engagement stat, plan times, 'Save for later', tracked checkmark, thinking spinner), amber warning (Steal these eyebrow bar, failure icon), green positive ('Your version' eyebrow). For a black/white system these all need monochrome equivalents. (4) ReelDetailSheet.swift has NO call sites (HomeView → ReelFeedPager → ReelStatsSheet); it is dead code — confirm with owner before spending redesign effort or deleting. (5) Behavior/pitfalls that must survive a visual rewrite: single-active-player claim logic in ReelCard (activeReelId binding); ScriptFeedCard fixed 260x220 (previous 190pt height clipped the Film row); .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) on ScriptFeedCard; TrendTicker's GeometryReader-wrapped marquee (prevents layout leak) and highPriorityGesture swipe with minimumDistance 24; ReelFeedPager's captured safe-area insets and Color.clear-owns-layout thumbnail (owner-reported bugs); ReelStatsSheet minimumScaleFactor on tiles ('ENGAGEME…' bug). (6) accessibilityIdentifiers used by Maestro that must remain: home.profile, home.voiceBubble, feed.pick, feed.like, feed.dismiss, feed.save, feed.moreScripts, feed.trend, feed.reel, voice.close, voice.mic, voice.textInput, voice.send, reelPager.close, reelPager.handle, reelPager.mimic, reelPager.track, reelPager.details, reelStats.close, reel.close, reel.mimic, reel.saveMimic. (7) Haptics present: VoiceBubble light impact on tap; VoiceSessionView impact on orb tap. Motion present: staggerReveal entrance, orb Canvas animation, trend marquee/slide transitions, skeleton shimmer, pick dismiss scale+opacity, reel-detail phase fades. No files were edited.

areas.notes: Scope files read fully: ChatView.swift (474 lines: ChatView + ChatAttachSheet), ChatComponents.swift (779: user bubble, assistant message, typing indicator, script card, clip-edit card, video-analysis card, suggested chips, morph send button, conversations drawer, private CoachPersonaPicker + LengthPicker), ChatEditConfigSheet.swift (181), ChatStore.swift (491, state only, no UI). Redesign-relevant observations: (1) The whole design system is light-only; there are no dark-mode color tokens anywhere in Theme.swift, so dark mode support must be added at the token level. (2) Non-black-and-white colors in chat today: Palette.accent blue (#2C6BED) on save links, toggles, slider, clip-edit progress bars/spinner, day-plan accent bar/times, selection ring/check in the config sheet; persona glow colors (blue/orange/tan) in the drawer; Palette.goldDeep (=accent) in ScriptReaderView. (3) Legacy dark-theme leftovers in ChatEditConfigSheet: TextField prompts colored .white.opacity(0.5) and the style placeholder Rectangle white 8% — both nearly invisible on the light canvas (accessibility issue worth fixing in the redesign). (4) The ConversationsDrawer uses .swipeActions on Buttons inside a ScrollView/VStack (not a List), so swipe-to-delete very likely does not work today; keep the delete affordance in the redesign but a working implementation would be a functional change — flag to the user. (5) The error message 'Hit a snag, tap to try again.' is plain text with no tap handler. (6) ChatView.pasteVideoLink() is dead code. (7) User-message content for attachments embeds a 📎 emoji (violates the 'no Apple emojis in UI' design rule) — it is written into persisted message content by ChatStore, so changing it is a data/copy change, not pure presentation. (8) Accessibility identifiers that must survive: chat.drawer, chat.newChat, chat.attach, chat.composer, chat.send, chat.chip.other, chat.scriptCard, chat.save, chat.saveVersion, chat.clipEdit.card, chat.clipEdit.retry, chat.clipEdit.viewInLibrary, chat.drawerBackdrop, chat.drawerClose, chat.newChatRow, chat.persona.{machine,closer,sergeant}, chat.length.{concise,medium,detailed}, chat.attachSource (+ segment.photos / segment.yourlibrary), chat.attachPhotos, chat.attachClip, chatEdit.style.N, chatEdit.reactSource, chatEdit.memeLevel, chatEdit.instruction, chatEdit.create; plus the .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) wrappers on ChatScriptCard, ClipEditCard and MarqueSegmented. (9) Layout contracts to keep: composer bottom padding switches between Space.sm and MarqueTabBar.clearance (84) driven by router.hideTabBar; composerFocused sets router.hideTabBar; scroll-to-bottom anchor + all onChange scroll triggers; drawer is an overlay not a sheet; user bubble maxWidth formula; chips hide on first keystroke. areas.notes:
FLOW ORDER (OnboardingView.Step, Int-backed, order matters for resume + progress math): landing(0) → niche(1) → connect(2) → identity(3: scan theater sub-state then audience) → goal(4) → frequency(5) → building(6: running / failed / ready sub-states) → notifications(7). quizTotal = 5 (niche, connect, identity, goal, frequency) — SegmentedProgress shows 5 dashes; building/notifications/landing show no progress and no back. Step position persists in @AppStorage 'onboarding.resumeStep.v3' and every entry fires store.backend.reportClientEvent('onboard_step', …). Do not renumber the enum or the resume key semantics change.

TRANSITIONS/MOTION to preserve: step change = .id(step) + asymmetric transition (forward: move from trailing + opacity; back: opacity), Motion.enter; single-select goal auto-advances after a cancellable 300ms Task with .sensoryFeedback(.impact light) on selectionTick; chips/toggles use Motion.spring; slider fires UIImpactFeedbackGenerator light per step; swiper commit haptic; tour cluster travels with spring(0.5/0.82) and crossfades copy+pose.

COLOR CONSTRAINTS FOR A B&W REDESIGN: the only chromatic elements in scope are (1) niche category dots + legend (accent blue / positive green / warning amber via Palette), (2) TourOverlay spotlight ring + active progress dot (Palette.accent blue), (3) Instagram badge gradient + 'Can post' green badge + green checkmark in ConnectAccountsView (out of scope file but rendered in the connect step), (4) critical red error text. Everything else is already ink/cream/white/hairline. The app forces .preferredColorScheme(.light) in MarqueApp.swift, so dark mode currently does not exist anywhere; Palette colors are hard-coded hex, not asset-catalog dynamic colors.

TYPOGRAPHY GOTCHA: Typeface.display ignores its weight parameter and always returns 'Fraunces-9ptBlack' (a heavy Black cut); sans is Matter (Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold/Light custom fonts). All font references go through Theme.swift, so tokens can be swapped centrally.

LAYOUT GOTCHAS: OnboardingScaffold is the single layout for every step (three modes: centered block, topAligned, scrollable-with-pinned-CTA) — restyle it once and every step follows. ChipCloud relies on estimatedWidth (8.4pt per char + 44 + 15 for dot) and Space.sm gaps for greedy packing; changing chip padding/font requires updating that estimate. SwiperStepShell card size is fixed 300×430 and its ZStack sizing via Color.clear + layer-level cornerRadius on the AVPlayerLayer are load-bearing (SwiftUI clipShape does not clip AVPlayerLayer). TourOverlay must stay full-screen ignoresSafeArea with global-coordinate math; mascot 104×130 and 16pt edge constants derive the bubble width per device.

ACCESSIBILITY IDS in scope (Maestro relies on them): onboard.start, onboard.haveAccount, onboard.back, onboard.progress, onboard.niche.<title>, onboard.niche.continue, connect.instagram, connect.tiktok, connect.linked, connect.remove, onboard.connect.consent, onboard.connect.continue, onboard.connect.skip, onboard.scanTheater, onboard.audience.derived, onboard.audience.<title>, onboard.audience.continue, onboard.goal.audience/clients/authority/monetize, onboard.paceSlider, onboard.pace.1/7/14/21, onboard.continue, onboard.buildRetry, onboard.finish, onboard.notifications.enable, onboard.notifications.skip, swiper.pass, swiper.undo, swiper.like, onboard.interview.answer, onboard.interview.next, tour.skip, tour.next (+ settings.replayTour, editingStyle.retake in callers).

screens.styleNotes: Intrinsically dark, over-camera UI: live Metal preview with a 45% black wash (or solid #1C1A17 night when no camera). Text is white at graded opacities (100/94/90/85/70/65/60/50/45/35%). Uppercase micro kickers (11 semibold, +1.4 tracking). Controls use LiquidGlassFill (ultraThinMaterial + milky lift + top sheen + 1.5pt luminous top rim) as 52pt circles and 30/44pt capsules; selected pills invert to solid white with ink text. Record button = 78pt white-50% ring + red (#C0452C) 62pt circle that morphs to a 32pt rounded square (radius 6) while recording. Review-phase panels are white-8% translucent rounded rects (radius 14); selected format card is solid white; selection accents (checkmarks, strokes, slider tints, 'Adjust' link, MEME level, CTA line in prompter) use the blue accent #2C6BED. Primary CTAs on this screen are inverted (white fill, ink text, radius 14, 20pt vertical padding) rather than the app's ink PrimaryButton. 'Save as draft' uses the light GhostButton (white card) which sits visually heavy on the dark bg. Motion: Motion.quick (0.2 easeInOut) for Adjust/retouch, easeOut 0.12–0.15 for picker selection, opacity+move(top) transition for expanded overrides; haptic: UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.warning) on delete-last-take only.

screens.name: Teleprompter (embedded in RecordView)
screens.purpose: Auto-scrolling, speed-adjustable, pausable, drag-scrubbable script display (hook / body / CTA) with tap-to-edit inline editing of each line while filming.
screens.presentation: embedded component inside RecordView (300pt frame) during ready/recording/paused/stitching phases for scripted takes; its edit mode is an in-place overlay
screens.reachedFrom: RecordView body when script != nil and showsPrompter
structureTopToBottom: VStack spacing 20, leading aligned: hook line (Typeface.sans 28 bold = Matter-Bold, white 94%), body line (Matter-Regular 23, lineSpacing 6, white 94%), CTA line (Matter-SemiBold 23, Palette.accent blue)
Each line has a pencil glyph (11pt, white 40%, padding 4) overlaid top-trailing as the edit affordance
Content offset by -offset (auto-scroll), clipped to the 300pt viewport, masked with a vertical LinearGradient clear→black→black→clear (fade at top and bottom edges)

Edit overlay (when a line is tapped): Color.black 70% scrim (ignoresSafeArea, tap = commit) + TextEditor (Matter 22, white, scrollContentBackground hidden, minHeight 120 maxHeight 240, padding 16, white 12% bg, radius 14, auto-focused) + row: 'Cancel' (callout white 70%) … 'Done' (headline accent); padding 20, centered
interactive: Tap hook / body / CTA line → startEdit(field): pauses running, opens editor
Drag gesture (minimumDistance 12) on the prompter → manual scrub; auto-pace suspends during drag and resumes from release point
Edit overlay: tap scrim → commitEdit(); 'Cancel' → discard; 'Done' → commitEdit() (empty/whitespace draft is ignored)
Driven externally: running (play/pause pill), speed (Slow/Normal/Fast), restartToken (resets offset to 0 on record/re-record)
states: Idle (not running): static at current offset
Running: 60Hz Timer.publish ticker advances offset by contentH / max(6, targetSeconds) * speed / 60 per tick, clamped to maxScroll = contentH - viewport*0.5
Dragging: dragBase captured, ticker paused
Editing (hook/body/cta): overlay shown, running forced false
No script text (freestyle) → component not shown at all
screens.styleNotes: White-on-dark large-type teleprompter; hook 28 bold, body 23 regular with generous line spacing, CTA in blue accent semibold. Soft gradient fade at both vertical edges. Faint pencil icons mark editability. Edit overlay is a translucent white-12% rounded text box over a 70% black scrim.
screens.functionalCoupling: Bindings: script (Binding<Script>, mutates hook.text/body/cta on commit — flows into liveScript, which RecordView passes to saveDraft/submit), running, speed, restartToken. TeleHeightKey PreferenceKey measures content height; ticker math (pxPerSec) and the maxScroll formula must stay identical.

areas.notes:
Scope summary: user-visible screens in this area are FilmView (hub, fullScreenCover root), CustomScriptSheet, QueueReorderSheet, the delete-draft confirmationDialog, ScriptReaderView (+ HookLabSheet) as the push bridge, RecordView with its 8 phases + importing overlay, and the embedded Teleprompter (with its edit overlay). The other files in scope are non-visual: CameraModel.swift (AVFoundation data-output → CoreImage → AVAssetWriter capture pipeline, retouch snapshot locking, plus the CameraPreview MTKView), FaceRetouch.swift (CIFilter bilateral-approximation skin smoothing + RetouchSettings UserDefaults persistence), VideoStitcher.swift (AVMutableComposition concat of multi-take segments, passthrough vs re-encode on mixed transforms), Media.swift (ThumbnailCache, MediaStore file helpers, PickedVideoFile transferable, importPickedMedia, and the LocalThumbnail/LocalVideoPlayer/ClipPreviewPlayer views). None of those four should be touched by a presentation redesign except the visual styling inside LocalThumbnail (placeholder fill/glyph) and, if desired, CameraPreview's black backing color.

Redesign-relevant observations: (1) Every color is a hardcoded light Palette constant — there is no dark-mode branch anywhere; RecordView is dark by construction (camera + white-alpha text), so a black-and-white system would need Palette to become dynamic (Color(uiColor:) / asset catalog) and RecordView's white-alpha ladder mapped to tokens. (2) The blue accent (#2C6BED) appears in FilmView (section bars, source pills, 'Reorder', 'Settings.' link, custom-script icon), ScriptReaderView (CTA text, edit links, bookmark, send button state), and throughout RecordView (selected checkmarks/strokes, slider tints, MEME level, 'Adjust', teleprompter CTA line, brief quote). Amber warning tints the draft section; red critical is the record button and error copy. (3) QueueReorderSheet is a stock system List (no Palette background) and SettingsView/ScriptVersionHistorySheet belong to other scopes. (4) GhostButton ('Save as draft') is a white light-surface component placed over the dark camera view. (5) The 'TELEPROMPTER' kicker is shown in every RecordView phase including freestyle and review. (6) Accessibility identifiers are load-bearing for Maestro E2E (record.capture single-tap simulator fast path, record.makeClips, record.makeMyClip, film.*, script.record) and must all survive. (7) Functional guards that must remain byte-for-byte: lastSeededFormat / styleSeeded reseed guards, submitTask double-submit guard, savedFootagePath dedup, hoisted-upload consume-not-cancel in makeClips, honest-failure gate on AppConfig.backendBaseURL, onDisappear cancel, pickedItems reset in onChange, contextMenu (not swipe) delete for drafts, editMode .active constant in the reorder sheet, and the Teleprompter ticker/maxScroll math. (8) Small-phone risk points already present: RecordView's fixed 300pt prompter + 560pt review ScrollView + 20pt paddings; the format grid reserves 2 blurb lines; the b-roll cards are fixed 118x148 and caption cards 62x96.

areas.notes: 1) ProEditorView is the ONLY forced-dark surface in this scope (`.preferredColorScheme(.dark)`, Palette.night full bleed, dark nav bar); TweakChatSheet, CTALibrarySheet, PipelineTimeline and the MarqueDialog cards are light (canvas/white). Palette.night is an alias of Palette.ink (#1C1A17) — every 'night' reference in the editor resolves to warm near-black. 2) The editor uses many hard-coded semantic hex colors outside Palette (yellow #FFD60A, green #34D399, amber #FFB020, roll amber #B56635, zoom purple #8B5CF6, music teal #2E7D6B, roll-ring teal #30D6C4, green-screen #0F3460, sticker swatches, caption accent swatches) plus Palette.accent blue; a black-and-white redesign must decide how to keep these DISTINGUISHABLE (speed vs mute vs transition vs cut-seam vs zoom vs text-card vs roll) using shape/weight/pattern rather than hue, since they carry meaning. Caption preset colors and sticker/accent color swatches are CONTENT the render uses (user-picked video colors), not UI chrome — keep the actual values, only restyle the pickers. 3) Layout constraints that are load-bearing: fixed heights (one bar 84, expansion 84, transport 32, panel rows 52/44/38/34/74, inline panels 300/320/340, filmstrip 64, lanes 28/26/20/30, ruler 12) are tuned for the iPhone SE budget; `timelineHeight` in ProEditorView, the lane frames in EditorTimeline, and `laneGutter` heights are three copies of the same numbers and must change together. Expansion rows deliberately REPLACE the toolbar slot rather than stack. 4) Inline panels (caption list, media, cleanup, restore) intentionally replace the timeline pane instead of system sheets (accessibility/automation visibility) — do not convert to sheets. Dialogs and sheets are attached at the root NavigationStack for the same reason. 5) Every `.accessibilityIdentifier` (all listed, prefix `editorPro.`, `tweak.`, `cta.`, `dialog.`) and every `.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)` is relied on by Maestro flows and by the identifier-leak fix documented in cleanupPanel — preserve verbatim. 6) Selection invariants: `select()` is the single writer of selection state; `toolbarState` priority order; saveNeedsRender must mirror save()'s split-only defer rule; one gesture = one perform() = one undo step (slider drafts commit on release). 7) Haptics: `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(.light), trigger: hapticTick)` on root; `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: snapTick)` in EditorTimeline. Animations are all easeOut 0.15–0.25 or easeInOut 0.25; toast 1.5s, hint 4.5s (once-ever UserDefaults flags 'editorPro.hint.*'), zoom pill 1.2s. 8) Only Apple-native surfaces in scope: the music and theme sheets use a stock `List`; MarqueToggle/MarqueSegmented from MarqueDialogs.swift are NOT used here. 9) CTALibrarySheet has no live entry point (RecordView.swift:878 documents it as dormant since build 63) — redesign it for consistency but it cannot be verified in the simulator without a temporary hook. 10) LocalEDLEngine.swift is a pure op engine (WireOp builders + local apply); no views — only its first ~80 lines were read, which suffices for the UI inventory. 11) The editor reads clip.localVideoPath / server source_url; in keyless/mock mode the canvas shows a Palette.ink placeholder with a film glyph and the filmstrip is solid — the redesign should style that placeholder too.

background: Palette.surface (white) ignoresSafeArea

tourOverlay -> TourOverlay(tour:router:anchors:) rendered full-screen ignoring safe area above tab bar + content

screens.name: Floating tab bar (MarqueTabBar)
screens.purpose: Custom 4-tab floating glass capsule with an INLINE center '+' Film button (no raised FAB). Labels are real text so Maestro taps by name.
screens.presentation: overlay pinned to bottom of RootTabView (never safeAreaInset)
screens.reachedFrom: Always visible in RootTabView unless router.hideTabBar
structureTopToBottom: HStack(spacing 0): [Home tab][Chat tab] [center + button, 48pt circle, horizontal padding 10] [Library tab][Performance tab]

Each tab button: VStack(spacing 3) — SF Symbol 20pt regular (sun.max / bubble.left.and.text.bubble.right / rectangle.stack / chart.bar) over label Typeface.sans(10, .medium), lineLimit 1, minScale 0.8

Container: vertical padding 8, horizontal 10, background .ultraThinMaterial in continuous Capsule; two strokes (white 35% 1pt + Palette.hairline 0.5pt); shadow black 8% radius 18 y 8; outer horizontal padding 16, bottom padding 4
interactive: Tab button 'Home' (AppTab.home, icon sun.max) — no accessibilityIdentifier, tour anchor none
Tab button 'Chat' (AppTab.chat, icon bubble.left.and.text.bubble.right) — tourAnchor 'tour.chat'

Center Film '+' button — accessibilityLabel 'Film', accessibilityIdentifier 'film.open', .sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .medium)) haptic on each tap (createTaps counter), tourAnchor 'tour.film'; calls onCreateTap -> router.showFilm = true
Tab button 'Library' (AppTab.library, icon rectangle.stack) — tourAnchor 'tour.library'
Tab button 'Performance' (AppTab.performance, icon chart.bar) — tourAnchor 'tour.performance'
states: selected tab: icon Palette.accent full, label textPrimary
unselected tab: icon Palette.accent @40% opacity, label textTertiary
hidden: whole bar removed with move-from-bottom + opacity transition when router.hideTabBar
screens.styleNotes: Liquid-glass capsule (.ultraThinMaterial) with hairline + white rim strokes and a soft black shadow. Center button is a 48pt circle filled with vertical LinearGradient accent blue -> accent@82%, white 28% 1pt ring, blue 42% glow shadow radius 10 y 4, white 'plus' 20pt semibold. Tab icons are BLUE (selected full / unselected 40%); labels 10pt Matter Medium in ink/tertiary. Static clearance constant 84pt.
screens.functionalCoupling: Binding<AppTab> selected; onCreateTap closure; static clearance = 84 (screens depend on this number for bottom padding); tourAnchor ids 'tour.chat', 'tour.film', 'tour.library', 'tour.performance' (must match TourManager.Step.id); accessibilityIdentifier 'film.open' and visible label text 'Home'/'Chat'/'Library'/'Performance' are used by Maestro tests.

screens.name: Guided tour overlay (TourOverlay)
screens.purpose: 5-step spotlight walkthrough (voice bubble, Chat, Film, Library, Performance) drawn over the whole shell; auto-runs once after onboarding and replays from Settings -> 'Replay walkthrough'.
screens.presentation: overlay (full-screen, ignoresSafeArea) on RootTabView via .tourOverlay; opacity transition
screens.reachedFrom: TourManager.startIfNeeded (Home first appearance) or Settings 'Replay walkthrough'
structureTopToBottom: Spotlight shape: full-screen black @62% with an animatable rounded-rect (18pt corners) hole around the target inset by -10pt; absorbs all touches
Accent ring: RoundedRectangle 16pt continuous, 3pt Palette.accent stroke, blue 50% glow shadow radius 8, positioned on the hole

Speech bubble (TourSpeechBubble): progress capsules (current 14x5 accent, others 5x5 tertiary@35%) / title Typeface.sans(18,.semibold) tracking tight / message AppFont.callout textSecondary / controls row; padding Space.lg; width derived = screenW - 2*16 - 104 - 8 (min 200); background surfaceRaised; radius Radius.lg 18; shadow black 28% radius 22 y 10

Mascot (TourMascotView): static per-step Yuni pose image (UnicornTourTalk/Type/Point/Chill/Cheer), 104pt wide, 130pt tall bottom-aligned, mirrored when placed on the right; falls back to UnicornMascot(pose: .hero)
Cluster placed below the target if target.midY < 55% of screen, else above; mascot on left when target is left-of-center or centered
interactive: 'Skip' text button — AppFont.callout textTertiary — accessibilityIdentifier 'tour.skip' — tour.skip()
'Next' / 'Got it' (last step) capsule button — ink fill, onInk 14pt Medium text, height 38, horizontal padding Space.lg — accessibilityIdentifier 'tour.next' — tour.next(router:)
Backdrop tap: absorbed, does nothing
states: inactive: overlay not rendered (tour.current nil or anchor missing)
step 1..5: bubble copy crossfades (.id(step.id) + opacity), bubble position + spotlight hole spring-animate (response 0.5, damping 0.82) to next control
last step: Next label reads 'Got it'
mascot asset missing: falls back to procedural UnicornMascot
screens.styleNotes: Dark 62% scrim, blue accent ring + glow, white card with 18pt radius, sans title 18 semibold. Progress indicator is a row of tiny capsules with the active one stretched (14pt) in blue. Uses Palette.accent, Palette.ink capsule CTA.
screens.functionalCoupling: TourManager (current, index, isLastStep, steps.count, next(router:), skip()), AppRouter (start pops homePath + selects .home), anchors dictionary from TourFrameKey preference — anchor ids 'tour.voiceBubble' (HomeView), 'tour.chat', 'tour.film', 'tour.library', 'tour.performance'. The geometry contract (global-coordinate frames, full-screen overlay origin) must be preserved or highlights drift.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Account & app settings: identity card, notification toggles, subscription (Pro + Plus upsell, restore, manage), account (email, sign out, delete), data & privacy (export, legal links), support & about (replay tour, support link, version).
screens.presentation: sheet (from ProfileView gear button 'profile.settings' and from FilmView's settings button), wrapped in its own NavigationStack with inline empty title and a trailing 'Done' toolbar button
screens.reachedFrom: Home -> Profile (pushed) -> gear icon; Film flow -> settings button
structureTopToBottom: Navigation bar: empty title (inline), trailing toolbar 'Done' (native text button, blue tint)
ScrollView > VStack(alignment .leading, spacing Space.lg=20) with .screenPadding() (20pt) and top padding 20
Editorial header: kicker 'YOUR ACCOUNT & APP' (AppFont.micro 11 semibold, tracking 1.4, textTertiary) over 'Settings' (Typeface.sans 34 bold, tracking -1, textPrimary)

Identity card (accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.identityCard'): HStack — AccountAvatarMark 52pt (blue gradient circle with initial) / displayName headline 17 semibold + niche caption (if brand.niche non-empty) / Spacer / 'Pro' green tinted Chip if store.subscription.isSubscribed. Padding 16, surfaceRaised white, radius 22 continuous, hairline stroke, warm shadow 6% radius 14 y 6

Group 'NOTIFICATIONS' (SectionLabel micro caps) card: MarqueToggleRow 'Daily film reminder' / 'A nudge each morning to keep your week full.' — textDivider — MarqueToggleRow 'Post published' / 'Know the moment a clip goes live.'

Group 'SUBSCRIPTION' card: row [ProMark dark-gradient bloom tile] 'Yunicorn Pro, {price}/mo' headline + 'Billed monthly. Cancel anytime.' caption + 'Active' green chip if subscribed (id 'settings.currentPlan') — insetDivider — Button row [PlusMark] 'Go Plus' / 'Remove the watermark from your exports.' (or 'Yunicorn Plus, active' / 'Clean exports, every look, priority renders.' + 'Plus' chip when entitlements.isPro) with chevron (id 'settings.goPro') — insetDivider — row 'Restore purchases' (arrow.clockwise UtilityMark; 'Restoring…' + disabled while restoring) (id 'settings.restore') — insetDivider — Link row 'Manage subscription' (creditcard) to apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions

Group 'ACCOUNT' card: row [AccountAvatarMark 36] email or 'Demo account' headline + 'Signed in' caption (id 'settings.accountEmail') — insetDivider — Button row 'Sign out' (DestructiveMark rectangle.portrait.and.arrow.right, critical red text) (id 'settings.signOut') — insetDivider — Button(role: .destructive) row 'Delete account' (DestructiveMark trash, red) (id 'settings.deleteAccount') — #if DEBUG: insetDivider + GhostButton 'Reset app to first run' (arrow.counterclockwise) padded 16 — #if DEBUG && simulator: textDivider + 'Demo tier (simulator only)' bodyL label + NATIVE segmented Picker Starter/Growth/Studio (id 'settings.demoTier') + optional info caption (demoTierInfo)

Group 'DATA & PRIVACY' card: ShareLink row 'Export my data' [PrivacyMark lock tile] (id 'settings.exportData', only when brand JSON-encodes) — insetDivider — Link row 'Privacy Policy' (hand.raised, textSecondary tint) — insetDivider — Link row 'Terms of Use' (doc.text)

Group 'SUPPORT & ABOUT' card: Button row 'Replay walkthrough' (arrow.triangle.2.circlepath UtilityMark tinted accent blue) (id 'settings.replayTour') — insetDivider — Link row 'Support' [SupportMark green three-dots tile] — insetDivider — HStack 'Version' headline + appVersion caption right-aligned (no chevron)
Footer: 'Yunicorn v{version} ({build})' micro textTertiary centered, top 8 / bottom 24

Overlays: marqueConfirm 'Sign out?' / 'Your brand stays on this device.' [Sign out (destructive red) / Cancel]; marqueConfirm 'Delete account?' / 'This permanently erases your brand, scripts, clips, and schedule from this device. This can't be undone.' [Delete (destructive) / Cancel]
sheet(isPresented: $showProPaywall) { YunicornProPaywall() } (out of scope, dark ink paywall)
interactive: Toolbar 'Done' button — dismiss()
MarqueToggle 'Daily film reminder' — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.reminders' — get store.remindersEnabled; set: on -> store.requestRemindersAndEnable(), off -> store.remindersEnabled = false
MarqueToggle 'Post published' — local @State notifPublished persisted to UserDefaults key 'notif.published'
Button 'Go Plus' / 'Yunicorn Plus, active' row — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.goPro' — showProPaywall = true
Button 'Restore purchases' — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.restore' — await store.subscription.restore(); disabled while restoring
Link 'Manage subscription' — opens https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions

Button 'Delete account' (role .destructive) — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.deleteAccount' — showDeleteConfirm = true; confirm -> store.resetAll(); dismiss()
DEBUG: GhostButton 'Reset app to first run' — store.resetAll(); dismiss()

DEBUG+simulator: native segmented Picker 'Demo tier' Starter/Growth/Studio — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.demoTier' — writes UserDefaults 'demo.tier', store.subscription.devContinue(), await store.backend.setDevTier()
ShareLink 'Export my data' — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.exportData' — shares JSON-encoded store.brand with subject 'Yunicorn Brand Data'
Link 'Privacy Policy' — LegalURLs.privacy (https://marque.app/privacy)
Link 'Terms of Use' — LegalURLs.terms (https://marque.app/terms)
Button 'Replay walkthrough' — accessibilityIdentifier 'settings.replayTour' — dismiss(); tour.start(router:)
Link 'Support' — LegalURLs.support (https://marque.app)
Dialog buttons via MarqueDialogCard: accessibilityIdentifier 'dialog.signout', 'dialog.delete', 'dialog.cancel'
states: subscribed (store.subscription.isSubscribed): 'Pro' chip on identity card + 'Active' chip on plan row
Plus entitled (Entitlements.shared.isPro): Plus row title/subtitle swap + 'Plus' chip instead of chevron
restoring: row label 'Restoring…' and button disabled
no niche: niche caption hidden on identity card

no loading, empty, or offline state of its own
screens.styleNotes: Canvas #F1F1EF off-white background. Cards: white surfaceRaised, radius 18 (groups) / 22 (identity), 1pt 8%-black hairline stroke, warm shadow (#2E2A20 @6%, radius 14, y 6). Rows: 13pt vertical / 16pt horizontal padding, 36pt circular icon tiles (SettingsIconTile) with tinted 10-12% fills and white 14% ring; dividers inset past the tile (16+36+16 = 68pt) or 16pt for toggle rows. Titles AppFont.headline (Matter SemiBold 17), captions Matter 13 textTertiary #97928A, section labels 11pt semibold uppercase tracking 1.4. Section header 'Settings' 34pt Matter Bold tracking -1 with 11pt uppercase kicker. Accent blue #2C6BED used for Replay walkthrough tint, toggles (on state), avatar gradient (accent -> #1B3E8C); ProMark tile is a dark gradient (#1C1A17 -> #3A362E) with white bloom rings; destructive rows red #C0452C; positive green #2F9E60 chips ('Pro', 'Active', 'Plus') and SupportMark. Chevron.right 12pt semibold textTertiary as trailing affordance. Custom MarqueToggle: 46x28 capsule, blue when on / tertiary@35% off, 22pt white knob.
screens.functionalCoupling: @Environment AppStore, AppRouter, TourManager, dismiss. Reads store.brand.creatorName/niche, store.auth.state?.email, store.subscription.isSubscribed/monthly.displayPrice/restore()/devContinue(), store.remindersEnabled + requestRemindersAndEnable(), store.resetAll(), store.auth.signOut(), store.backend.setDevTier(), Entitlements.shared.isPro, tour.start(router:), UserDefaults keys 'notif.published' and 'demo.tier', Bundle version strings, LegalURLs.*, YunicornProPaywall sheet. All accessibilityIdentifiers above are Maestro hooks.

PlusMark: accent@12% tile; 16pt accent ring + 5pt accent dot
AccountAvatarMark(label:size:): vertical gradient accent #2C6BED -> #1B3E8C; uppercase initial (Matter Bold 18 if size >= 44 else 14) white; '•' fallback

UtilityMark(systemImage:tint:): tint@10% tile; SF Symbol .fill variant 14 medium in tint
states: AccountAvatarMark: empty label -> '•' glyph

screens.name: Script reader (ScriptReaderView)
screens.purpose: Read, edit (hook / body / CTA inline), refine via chips or free text, bookmark, view version history, and launch recording for one Script.
screens.presentation: push (FilmView navigationDestination(for: Script.self)) OR sheet wrapped in NavigationStack (HomeView peekedScript, ChatView peekedScript). Hides the floating tab bar while visible (router.hideTabBar = true on appear / false on disappear).
screens.reachedFrom: Film flow script list (push); Home feed pick card tap (sheet); Chat script card tap (sheet)
structureTopToBottom: Navigation bar: inline title 'Script'; LEADING clock.arrow.circlepath button (only when live.versionHistory non-empty), tinted textSecondary; TRAILING bookmark / bookmark.fill button tinted accent
ScrollView > VStack(alignment .leading, spacing Space.xl=24), screenPadding 20, vertical padding 20

Hook section: HStack with Spacer + trailing 'Edit'/'Done' text button (AppFont.callout 14 medium; 'Edit' = goldDeep alias of accent blue, 'Done' = accent). Below: either TextField('Hook', axis .vertical) in Matter Bold 30 on surfaceRaised radius 14 padding 16, OR a plain-style Button showing hook text at Typeface.sans(30,.bold) tracking -0.5 lineSpacing 3 with an inline trailing 'arrow.up.right' 13pt semibold textTertiary glyph (opens HookLabSheet)
MarqueHairline (0.5pt textPrimary@12%)

Body section (.marqueCard: padding 20, white, radius 22, hairline, warm shadow 7% radius 18 y 8): header row SectionTitle 'SCRIPT' (micro caps tracking 1.4) + Spacer + 'Edit' (goldDeep/accent) or 'Done' (accent) text button; then TextEditor(bodyDraft) bodyL 16, minHeight 120, surfaceRaised radius 10 (editing) OR Text(live.body) bodyL lineSpacing 7 tappable-to-edit; then CTA: TextField('Call to action', axis .vertical) bodyL in goldDeep/accent color on surfaceRaised radius 10 padding 8 + 'Done' button (editing) OR Text(live.cta) bodyL in accent blue, tappable-to-edit

Refine section: SectionTitle 'REFINE'; horizontal ScrollView of Chip buttons 'Shorter' / 'More contrarian' / 'Funnier' / 'More personal' (white capsule, hairline, callout 14 medium textSecondary, 14x9 padding, faint shadow); HStack(alignment .bottom): TextField 'Tell Yunicorn what to change…' (AppFont.body 15, 1-3 lines, padding 16x11, surfaceRaised, radius 22 capsule-ish, hairline) + 38pt circular send button (arrow.up 14 semibold onInk on Palette.ink; textTertiary@40% when disabled); 'Rewriting…' row (small ProgressView tinted gold/accent + caption textTertiary) while steering; list of applied refinements as checkmark 10pt + caption textTertiary rows

safeAreaInset bottom: PrimaryButton 'Record this script' with systemImage record.circle (54pt ink fill, radius 14, onInk headline, shadow black 12%) on .ultraThinMaterial strip, horizontal padding 20 / vertical 8
interactive: Toolbar 'Version history' button (clock.arrow.circlepath) — accessibilityLabel 'Version history', accessibilityIdentifier 'script.versionHistory' — only shown when live.versionHistory non-empty — presents ScriptVersionHistorySheet
Toolbar bookmark button — accessibilityLabel 'Save for later', accessibilityIdentifier 'script.save' — toggles store.readyScript(live, source: .daily) / store.removeReadiedScript(saved)
Hook 'Edit'/'Done' text button — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.editHook' — enters hook edit or commitHookEdit() -> store.commitScriptEdit(scriptId:hookText:)
Hook TextField (editing) — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.hookEditor'
Hook text Button — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.hookButton' — showHookLab = true
Body 'Edit' button — bodyDraft = live.body; editingBody = true; bodyFocused = true (no identifier)
Body 'Done' button — commitBodyEdit() -> store.commitScriptEdit(scriptId:body:)
Body TextEditor — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.bodyEditor' — @FocusState bodyFocused
Body Text — onTapGesture enters body edit
CTA TextField — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.ctaEditor'; 'Done' button commitCTAEdit() -> store.commitScriptEdit(scriptId:cta:)
CTA Text — onTapGesture enters CTA edit
Refine chips 'Shorter' / 'More contrarian' / 'Funnier' / 'More personal' — each accessibilityIdentifier 'script.steer' — applyRefinement(label)
Refine TextField — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.refineField' — @FocusState refineFocused, onSubmit sendRefine()
Refine send button (arrow.up circle) — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.refineSend' — disabled unless canSendRefine (non-empty draft and not steering)
PrimaryButton 'Record this script' — accessibilityIdentifier 'script.record' — showRecord = true -> fullScreenCover RecordView(script: live)
sheet HookLabSheet(script: live); sheet ScriptVersionHistorySheet(scriptId: live.id); fullScreenCover RecordView(script: live)
states: viewing (default): hook hero, body card, refine section, record CTA
editing hook: TextField replaces hook text; button reads 'Done' in accent
editing body: TextEditor replaces body text; header button 'Done'
editing CTA: TextField + 'Done' replaces CTA line
steering (refine in flight): 'Rewriting…' spinner row visible; send button disabled; chips still visible but applyRefinement guards re-entry
applied refinements: growing checkmark log under the refine field (session-local)
bookmarked: toolbar icon bookmark.fill (from store.readiedScripts)
no version history: leading toolbar button absent
tab bar hidden for this screen
screens.styleNotes: Canvas #F1F1EF. Hook is the hero at 30pt Matter Bold tracking -0.5 in ink #1C1A17; body card white radius 22 with warm shadow; body text 16pt lineSpacing 7; CTA text rendered in accent blue (goldDeep alias = #2C6BED). Edit affordances are bare text buttons in blue ('Edit' goldDeep, 'Done' accent). Refine chips are white capsules with hairline; refine input is a 22pt-radius white field with an ink circular send button. Bottom CTA is the shared 54pt ink PrimaryButton on an ultraThinMaterial strip. Toolbar bookmark tinted blue.

areas.notes:
Key findings for the redesign planner:

1. Dark mode is currently DISABLED at the root: MarqueApp applies .preferredColorScheme(.light) to the whole WindowGroup, and Palette is a flat set of hard-coded light hex values (no Color asset catalog, no dynamic colors). YunicornProPaywall separately forces .dark. Supporting dark mode means (a) removing the root override, (b) turning Palette into scheme-aware colors, and (c) checking every literal Color(hex:) / .white / .black usage (SettingsIcons, tab bar rims, dialogs, TourOverlay scrim) — all presentation-only changes.

2. Blue accent (#2C6BED) is everywhere the user wants black-and-white: tab-bar icons (selected 100% / unselected 40%), the center '+' gradient button and its glow, MarqueToggle on-state, avatar gradient, 'Edit'/'Done' text buttons and the CTA line color in ScriptReaderView (via the goldDeep/gold aliases), the 'CURRENT' label and revert glyph in version history, the tour spotlight ring + progress capsule, Replay-walkthrough icon tint, HookLab/Refine spinners, and RankSeal's 'gold' ring (aliases to accent). Green positive (#2F9E60) is used for 'Pro'/'Active'/'Plus' chips and SupportMark; red critical for Sign out / Delete rows and the destructive dialog action — decide whether critical stays red for accessibility or becomes ink with a different affordance.

3. The tab bar is a custom overlay (NOT SwiftUI TabView) with a hard geometry contract: rendered as .overlay(alignment: .bottom), screens self-pad by MarqueTabBar.clearance (84). Any restyle must keep: the overlay approach, the static clearance value (or update every consumer), the visible label strings 'Home'/'Chat'/'Library'/'Performance' (Maestro taps by text), accessibilityIdentifier 'film.open', the .sensoryFeedback haptic on the Film button, and the tourAnchor ids (tour.chat / tour.film / tour.library / tour.performance).

4. Settings has two NATIVE controls that break the custom language: the toolbar 'Done' text button (also in ScriptVersionHistorySheet and HookLabSheet) and the DEBUG/simulator-only native segmented Picker (id 'settings.demoTier'). The MarqueSegmented shared component exists but is not used there. All Settings rows carry Maestro identifiers (settings.identityCard, settings.reminders, settings.currentPlan, settings.goPro, settings.restore, settings.accountEmail, settings.signOut, settings.deleteAccount, settings.demoTier, settings.exportData, settings.replayTour) plus dialog.* ids — keep them.

5. Settings row 'Export my data' is a ShareLink and 'Manage subscription' / 'Privacy Policy' / 'Terms of Use' / 'Support' are Link views (open Safari) — they must remain Link/ShareLink, only their label views should be restyled.

6. ScriptReaderView hides the tab bar on appear and is presented THREE ways (push from FilmView, sheet-in-NavigationStack from HomeView and ChatView) — navigation-bar styling needs to work in both push and sheet contexts. Its inline edit affordances are text buttons ('Edit'/'Done') plus tap-to-edit gestures on the body and CTA text; the refine field uses @FocusState and onSubmit. Bookmark state comes from store.readiedScripts.

7. CelebrationView uses the only raster image in scope ('FlameIcon' PNG); RankSeal is code-drawn (ink disc, accent ring, serif Roman numeral) and shared with ProfileView. The onDisappear clearing of store.pendingRankUp is load-bearing (documented flash bug) — do not move it.

8. TourOverlay geometry (global-coordinate anchors, full-screen ignoresSafeArea overlay) is a documented fragile contract; restyle only the bubble card, ring, scrim colors and mascot treatment. Mascot images are the app's own illustrations (Yuni unicorn), not Stoic's.

9. SubmitConfig.swift is non-visual backend wire contract — exclude from the redesign entirely.

10. Fonts bundled: Matter (Regular/Light/Medium/SemiBold/Bold), Fraunces (Regular = 9pt Black cut, Italic), Inter 400-700, PlayfairDisplay (+Italic). In-scope screens use Matter only (Typeface.sans); no serif appears on these screens except RankSeal's system serif numeral. Typography for these screens: 34/30/28 bold headlines, 17 semibold row titles, 16 body, 13 captions, 11 uppercase tracked kickers.

11. Cross-cutting shared component consumers outside this scope: MarqueToggleRow is also used in ChatEditConfigSheet, EditingStyleSheet, ScheduleComponents; RankSeal in ProfileView; marqueConfirm/dialogs app-wide — changing these shared components restyles those screens too.

12. Accessibility: no Dynamic Type (all custom fixed sizes); tab labels use minimumScaleFactor 0.8; tertiary text #97928A on #F1F1EF is roughly 2.9:1 contrast today — the black-and-white pass should raise tertiary text contrast.

areas.notes:
Coverage: every Swift file in scope was read in full (LibraryView.swift 1332 lines, GroupAssignSheet.swift, ConnectAccountsView.swift, Performance/{PerformanceView,StrategyView,ScheduleComponents,InteractiveSparkline}.swift, Profile/{ProfileView,EditingStyleSheet}.swift) plus the design system (DesignSystem/Theme.swift, Components.swift, MarqueDialogs.swift), App/MarqueTabBar.swift (clearance), and the entry points (App/RootTabView.swift lines 41-42 for Library/Performance tab roots; Features/Home/HomeView.swift line 70 pushes ProfileView; Features/Onboarding/OnboardingView.swift line 291 embeds ConnectAccountsView). No files were edited.

Key facts for a Stoic-style black/white redesign:
1) NO DARK MODE EXISTS. Palette is a flat enum of light hex constants (no Color(uiColor:) dynamic providers, no colorScheme branches). Dark mode support means rewriting Palette as dynamic colors; every screen here reads only Palette/AppFont/Space/Radius tokens, so token-level changes propagate everywhere, but many call sites also use raw `.white`, `.black.opacity(x)`, `Color.white.opacity(0.55)` strokes on glass, and `Palette.onInk` assumptions that break when ink flips.
2) NON-MONOCHROME COLOR CURRENTLY IN USE (must be re-mapped for a B&W system): accent blue 0x2C6BED (Select/Done links, bulk icons, selection overlays, sparkline, PipelineTimeline rails, SectionLabel accent bars, confidence badges, pillar/caption/b-roll selection strokes, MarqueToggle on-state, native Slider/Toggle tints, avatar tint, tab-bar icons); status family green/amber/red/purple (ClipStatus.railColor, PostRow status capsules, 'Can post' badge, analysis-failed badge, warning banners, delete pills); arbitrary per-item colors from data (ClipGroup.displayColorHex dots, Pillar.colorHex dots + slider tints, Catalog.pillarColors); Instagram brand gradient in PlatformBadge (code-drawn, no asset); RankSeal 'gold' (aliases to accent). StrategyModel.Confidence embeds a Color tint inside the parser output — re-point tints there rather than altering parsing.
3) GLASS: LiquidGlassFill (ultraThinMaterial + white speculars + luminous white top rim + cool shadow) is used on Performance compact toggles, stat tiles, the Strategy door, Connect cards, and the floating tab bar/bulk bar (.ultraThinMaterial capsules). These are the most 'un-Stoic' surfaces and depend on white overlays.
4) NATIVE CONTROLS STILL PRESENT (inconsistent with the branded set): native `Toggle` in BulkScheduleSheet, native `Slider` in Voice/Pillars/Meme/…, native `.alert` for 'New group' (ClipsSection) and 'No account connected' (SchedulePickerSheet), native `.confirmationDialog` for bulk delete, `Menu`+`Picker` for group filter / platform filter / time picker, AVKit `VideoPlayer` in PostEditorSheet vs InkVideoPlayer elsewhere, `PhotosPicker`.
5) LAYOUT CONTRACTS TO PRESERVE: LibraryView owns selection state so the bulk bar can be a screen-level .overlay padded MarqueTabBar.clearance(84)+8 above the floating tab bar (documented Maestro-reproduced regression if reduced); ClipsSection adds clearance+76 spacer while selecting; Performance pads bottom 120, Profile 120; PillarsEditorSheet hosts marqueConfirm on the ROOT (dialog clips inside cards otherwise); CalSheet is a single .sheet(item:) enum to avoid the two-sheet conflict; ClipDetailSheet's player .id() key must keep concatenating previewURL+remoteURL+renderLocalPath+localVideoPath; EditingStyleSheet's 250ms match debounce; PillarsEditorSheet commit-on-disappear unless Cancel.
6) SHEET PRESENTATION SUMMARY: ClipDetailSheet (default detent, own nav), PostNowSheet (.medium, no nav chrome), VersionTimelineSheet (.medium/.large, no nav chrome), VersionPreviewSheet (own nav), BulkScheduleSheet (own nav), GroupAssignSheet (.medium/.large, own nav), MediaEditSheet (own nav), StrategyView (own nav), SchedulePickerSheet / PostEditorSheet (own nav), all Profile sub-sheets (own nav), EditingStyleSheet retake (nested sheet own nav), ConnectAccountsView as a BARE sheet with no title/close from the three scheduling sheets (only swipe-down), ProEditorView as fullScreenCover, PaymentScreen as sheet from PostNow/BulkSchedule/PostEditor.
7) TYPOGRAPHY: entirely Matter sans in this scope (sizes 40/34/30/24/22/21/20/18/17/16/15/14/13/12/11/10/9/8); the Fraunces serif is effectively unused here despite comments mentioning it; uppercase micro kickers with 1.4 tracking are the recurring editorial motif (YOUR CREATIVE VAULT, COMING UP, FROM YOUR AI, PERFORMANCE, YOUR COACH, POST NOW, EDIT HISTORY, REVISION n, YOUR ONE MOVE, YOUR SIGNATURE CUT, CLOSEST MATCH TO YOUR STYLE, WHAT YUNICORN KNOWS, WORKING ON, BRAND, ACCOUNTS).
8) Accessibility identifiers are listed per element above; several controls have none (profileRow doors, stat row, Chip toggles, native Toggle/Sliders, insight rows, month-grid days, 'Remove from library/schedule', Cancel buttons) — a redesign should keep existing ids verbatim since Maestro flows (.maestro/library-groups.yaml etc.) depend on them.
9) Mobbin MCP status: the Mobbin server requires authentication and this session is non-interactive, so it was not used for this inventory task (not needed here); the user must authorize it before the research step of the wider workflow can run.

designSystem.darkModeSupport: "NONE — the app is hard-locked to LIGHT. `MarqueApp.swift:62` applies `.preferredColorScheme(.light)` on the root WindowGroup content (alongside `.tint(Palette.accent)`). Every Palette color is a fixed sRGB `Color(hex:)` literal with no light/dark pair, no `Color(\"name\")` asset lookups, no `@Environment(\\.colorScheme)` reads, no `UITraitCollection`/`overrideUserInterfaceStyle`, no `UIUserInterfaceStyle` key in Info.plist, and no imageset/colorset in Assets.xcassets carries an `appearance` (dark) variant. Three screens force `.preferredColorScheme(.dark)` locally purely so system chrome (status bar, keyboard, sheets) matches their hand-painted black surfaces: ReelFeedPager.swift:104, YunicornProPaywall.swift:33, ProEditorView.swift:155 — those screens (plus RecordView, PaymentScreen, SignInScreen, EditorTimeline/Tracks) paint white text on `Palette.night`/`.black` with literal `.white`/`.black` colors rather than adaptive tokens. The docs/02-design-system.md spec describes an Environment-driven `Theme.resolve(for: scheme)` with light/dark token sets, but that was never implemented; Theme.swift is a flat enum of statics. Consequence for the redesign: adding dark mode requires (1) making every Palette token adaptive (e.g. `Color(uiColor: UIColor { trait in ... })` or asset-catalog colorsets), (2) removing the root `.preferredColorScheme(.light)`, (3) replacing ~400 literal `.white`/`.black` usages and 22 hardcoded hex values in 8 feature files, and (4) reconsidering the three local `.dark` overrides and the white-gradient LiquidGlass speculars which assume a light surface."

designSystem.notes:
"SCOPE FILES READ IN FULL: DesignSystem/Theme.swift (185 lines), Components.swift (472), MarqueDialogs.swift (402), InkVideoPlayer.swift (235), FailableVideoPlayer.swift (108), NetworkMonitor.swift (29); App/MarqueApp.swift, MarqueTabBar.swift, RootTabView.swift; Features/SettingsIcons.swift; Resources/Assets.xcassets (all 26 Contents.json), Resources/Fonts (fc-scan), project.yml, Info.plist. No files were edited.

CURRENT VISUAL IDENTITY (per Theme.swift header): 'modeled on maxapp' — white/off-white canvas (#FFFFFF cards on #F1F1EF ground), warm near-black ink text (#1C1A17), 8%-black hairlines, soft warm shadows, ink-fill 54pt pill-ish buttons (radius 14), blue #2C6BED accent for links/selection/tab icons/FAB/toggles/sparklines, Matter sans body + Fraunces-Black serif for hero titles, uppercase +1.4-tracked 11pt micro labels as section eyebrows, 'liquid glass' material surfaces over camera/media and on the floating capsule tab bar. Dark surfaces (camera, editor, reel feed, paywall) are hand-painted black with literal white.

WHAT IS ALREADY CLOSE TO STOIC B&W: canvas/surface/text/hairline tokens are neutral; ink buttons; hairline cards; editorial empty states; uppercase micro labels. WHAT FIGHTS A PURE B&W STOIC LOOK: (1) Palette.accent blue in 169 places incl. tab bar icons, FAB gradient+glow, MarqueToggle ON state, player progress bar, Sparkline, SettingsIcons tints, accentMuted; (2) status colors positive/warning/critical/scheduled (55 usages) and the 6-hue Catalog.pillarColors used for pillar/group dots; (3) LiquidGlass white speculars/sheen and the glass tab bar; (4) shadowCool purple-tinted float shadows; (5) 22 hardcoded hex + ~400 literal .white/.black in 8 feature files (Editor, Record, Gate, SignIn, SettingsIcons, OnboardingComponents, FeedCards, ConnectAccountsView); (6) Instagram/Google brand gradients in ConnectAccountsView/SignInScreen; (7) the AccentColor.colorset is still gold #C9A227 (legacy, overridden by .tint).

MOTION TOKENS (Theme.swift `enum Motion`): calm easeInOut 0.45 (6 uses; gate transitions) | enter easeOut 0.38 (5; stagger reveal) | quick easeInOut 0.2 (24; tab/segment switches, tab-bar hide) | breath easeInOut 2.4 repeatForever autoreverse (2) | spring response 0.42 damping 0.82 (9). Dialogs use 0.18s easeOut; MarqueToggle 0.28 spring; SegmentedProgress 0.38 easeOut; ProgressRing 0.9 easeOut; Sparkline 0.8 easeOut; ShineSweep 1.4s loop after 2s delay; InkVideoPlayer chrome 0.18–0.25s and 2.4s auto-hide. No Reduce Motion checks anywhere in the design system.

HAPTICS (10 sites, none centralized): MarqueTabBar FAB .impact(.medium); VoiceBubble .impact(.light); VoiceSessionView mic .impact; EditorTimeline snap .selection; ProEditorView .impact(.light); SwiperStepShell commit .impact(.light); OnboardingView selection .impact(.light) + UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.light); RecordView UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.warning).

FailableVideoPlayer shows stock AVPlayerViewController controls where showsControls=true.
